Package org.apache.hadoop.io.erasurecode.rawcoder

Interface RawErasureCoderFactory

All Known Implementing Classes:
DummyRawErasureCoderFactory, NativeRSRawErasureCoderFactory, NativeXORRawErasureCoderFactory, RSLegacyRawErasureCoderFactory, RSRawErasureCoderFactory, XORRawErasureCoderFactory
@Private public interface RawErasureCoderFactory
Raw erasure coder factory that can be used to create raw encoder and decoder. It helps in configuration since only one factory class is needed to be configured.
